name: Valetta
description: Valetta is a high-ranking, sharp-witted high priestess and administrator representing the House of Inspired Hands (the temple of Gond) in Waterdeep. Intelligent, inventive, and deeply dedicated to the patron god of artisans and crafters, she oversees temple projects, evaluates new technological and magical inventions, and manages contracts with city guild members.
ideals: Innovation: 'Gond provides the spark, but human hands and ingenuity must turn that spark into works that elevate all of civilization.'
Progress: 'A machine or idea left unbuilt is a wasted prayer to the Lord of All Smiths.'
bonds: The House of Inspired Hands and the community of inventors, tinkers, and smiths across Waterdeep.
The Gondian priesthood and their sacred workshops.
flaws: Can become overly obsessed with technical specifications and complex mechanical theories, occasionally ignoring practical or social nuances.
speech_patterns: Articulate, precise, and enthusiastic, peppering her speech with engineering terms and references to design efficiency.
mannerisms: Inspects small gadgets with a jeweler's loupe, traces blueprints with an ink-stained finger, and taps her chin thoughtfully when analyzing a new invention.
motivations: To advance mechanical and magical innovations, support the city's guild artisans, and honor Gond through continuous creation.
knowledge: Expertise in divine magic associated with Gond, mechanical engineering, architectural design, and the inventory of temple inventions.
gm_notes: Valetta serves as a primary religious and technological contact for the party. She can be used to appraise magical or mechanical items, commission custom inventions, or offer quests involving stolen temple blueprints or runaway constructs.
